subject: Hosted API: SDKs, streaming & tooling — architecture breakdown session
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@medlinkhealth.com>, Dr. Laura Miles <laura.miles@medlinkhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API: SDKs, streaming & tooling — architecture breakdown session

Hi Sam / Laura —

Thanks again for the time on the call last week. As discussed, we’d like to run a focused architecture breakdown that covers the Hosted API integration patterns you flagged: SDK usage, streaming token flows, and tool/function calling for your triage workflow. The goal is a concrete next-step plan and a short mutual action list so your eng team can start a pilot.

Proposed 60-minute slots (PST):
- Tue Dec 22, 9:30–10:30am PST
- Wed Dec 23, 11:00am–12:00pm PST
- Mon Jan 4, 8:00–9:00am PST

Suggested agenda (attached):
1) Brief goals & constraints (5m)
2) Current integration review (SDK patterns + auth) (15m)
3) Streaming and token lifecycle (20m)
4) Tool/function calling patterns and security considerations (10m)
5) Action items & pilot checklist (10m)

I’ve attached a first-pass architecture sketch and the session agenda. If any of the proposed times conflict with your team, tell me what works and we’ll adjust. Karthik and Monica from our side will lead the technical walkthrough; Ava will be on for runtime/latency questions.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0136

Attachments:
- redwood-hosted-arch-v1.pdf (diagram, 1 page)
- session-agenda-20261220.md (text)
From: Sam Park <sam.park@medlinkhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Dr. Laura Miles <laura.miles@medlinkhealth.com>, Onboarding Ops <onboard@medlinkhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 18:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Hosted API: SDKs, streaming & tooling — architecture breakdown session

Evelyn —

Thanks for the clear agenda and the diagram. We’d love to do this before the end of the year, but the proposed PST times on Dec 22/23 overlap with our clinicians’ end-of-day debriefs. Could we move it slightly later in the day (PST) or shift to the following week? Our preferred windows (PST) are:
- Wed Dec 23, 2:00–3:00pm PST
- Thu Dec 24 is a short day for most of the team, so not ideal
- Tue Jan 5, 9:00–10:00am PST

Also — two things for the session:
1) Can you include an example of the SDK token refresh flow (we currently use short-lived tokens and a proxy).
2) We’d like to validate data flow for tool calls — there may be PHI in the payloads so the security section should include our expected controls (KMS, no persistent logging).

Laura and I will be on the call; copying our onboarding alias to coordinate calendar invites.

Best,
Sam Park
Director, Platform Integrations | MedLink Health
sam.park@medlinkhealth.com

Sam —

Thanks — that makes sense. I’ve updated the options and scheduled a 60-minute slot on Wed Dec 23 at 2:00–3:00pm PST (details below). If that slips for any reason, we also hold Tue Jan 5, 9:00–10:00am PST as a fallback.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-mlink-arch-20261220
Agenda (short):
- 2m: introductions & goals
- 12m: review current integration and SDK auth pattern (bring any diagrams you have)
- 20m: streaming behavior & token lifecycle — examples from SDK and recommended proxy configuration
- 15m: tool/function calling & PHI handling (KMS, no-persist rules, audit logs)
- 11m: action items + next steps (pilot kickoff date)

Prep requests for your team:
- A short (one slide) diagram of your current proxy/token flow
- Example payloads (sanitized) you expect to send to functions/tooling

Karthik will walk the streaming patterns; Monica will capture the mutual action plan. Ava will have the runtime notes on latency/kv cache implications for streaming long-lived connections.

If you want a pre-call 15-minute sync for the internal MedLink engineer to walk us through the proxy, we can add that as well — optionally.

Best,
Evelyn

Hi Sam / Laura —

Thanks for confirming — invite is on the calendar for Wed Dec 23, 2:00–3:00pm PST. Quick notes for the session so we can make it actionable:
- We will record the session and drop notes into a shared Drive folder afterward.
- If you have a sanitized example payload, please email it to onboard@medlinkhealth.com and we’ll ingest it into the demo runner (no logs will be persisted).
- On PHI: our recommended pattern is envelope encryption with customer KMS + transient in-memory processing; we’ll outline the exact controls during the call.

Forwarding the invite to Karthik and Ava so they have the calendar entry. If anything changes on your side, ping me and we’ll reschedule — otherwise see you Wednesday.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
